summary: Extend existing Android network safety and Tier0/Health Manager ownership to keep the Termux runtime exempt from background network restrictions.
reason: RDC and Slack share the Termux runtime and were simultaneously isolated while the phone remained online; live policy inspection also found the shared Termux UID absent from the Data Saver whitelist.

tests.name: runtime-targeted
tests.evidence: Guard, Slack runtime contract and Tier0 targeted tests pass; final count is recorded before publication.

tests.name: live-drift-repair
tests.evidence: With Data Saver disabled, UID 10554 was temporarily removed under a restore trap; candidate re-added it and verified all installed Termux-family protections healthy.

tests.name: tier0-critical-capability-preservation
tests.evidence: Activation exposed the installer dropping ADB/RDC from the soak set; source now accepts explicit critical capabilities and otherwise preserves the current list. Final regression follows.

tests.name: tier0-release-source-attribution
tests.evidence: Activation exposed source_commit=unknown from an incorrect parent calculation; installer now resolves HEAD directly from the nested source directory and final activation must verify the exact commit.

capabilities.reason: The existing network-safety owner now also maintains Termux background-network survivability.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing guard, Health Manager and Tier0 bootstrap only; no new daemon, scheduler, store, router or recovery owner.

rollback: Promote the previous immutable Tier0 LKG and revert this scoped private runtime commit after checking concurrent work.
limitations: Exact low-level radio/carrier trigger of the earlier outage is not proven.
Activation and screen-off/idle E2E acceptance are separate gates after source publication.
